item.title: Israel strikes Iran as drone hits Bahrain refinery, oil surges past $115 and Trump defends price spike
item.description: Israeli airstrikes hit regime targets in Isfahan as Iranian drone attack injures dozens at Bahrain refinery; oil jumps above $115 while Donald Trump says higher prices are a 'very small price to pay' for global security

item.title: IDF launches targeted raid in southern Lebanon: 'The end is not near, it will take time'
item.description: Israeli forces doubled troop levels along the Lebanon border and launched a focused raid against Hezbollah near the frontier, while airstrikes continued in Iran against regime command centers and missile sites’

item.title: One dead, one critical after missile strike at central Israel construction site; man seriously hurt elsewhere
item.description: Iran fires missile barrages across Israel as rockets are also launched from Lebanon; air defenses intercept most threats, but a missile with a split warhead hits central Israel, killing a man and critically wounding another at a Yehud construction site; IDF strikes Hezbollah t...

item.title: Israel expands travel warnings to Armenia, Georgia and Azerbaijan
item.description: The National Security Council urges Israelis to avoid travel to three additional countries and warns of heightened Iranian efforts to target Israelis and Jews abroad since the launch of Operation Roaring Lion

item.title: Macron urges Iran to halt regional attacks as Israel strikes IRGC air force headquarters in Tehran
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron calls on Tehran to stop attacks and reopen the Strait of Hormuz as the IDF says it destroyed the IRGC air force headquarters in Tehran, a key command center for Iran’s missiles and drones

item.title: 'Proud to lead on International Women’s Day': female IDF officers on front lines of war with Iran
item.description: IDF says thousands of women are leading operational efforts on the front lines and home front in the war with Iran; 'My soldiers and I will remain here as long as needed to protect Israel and its citizens,' says the navy’s first female missile ship commander

item.title: Trump: I’ll decide when Iran war ends with Netanyahu
item.description: US president says final call on ending the conflict will be his, while Secretary of War Pete Hegseth warns Iran will face 'unconditional surrender' as US and Israeli strikes expand

item.title: Man lightly wounded in Ramla, kindergarten damaged after Lebanon rocket fire
item.description: Alerts issued without preliminary warning as Hezbollah fires from Lebanon, debris impact reported in Beit Shemesh; earlier Iranian missiles trigger sirens in central Israel
